name: applied-filters
description: Applied-filter summary with a live count, removable chips and an edit action.
designIntent: Filter panels close, collapse or move into a drawer. AppliedFilters keeps the active set visible outside the panel and gives the user one place to edit or clear it.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Opens the filter panel for editing.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional summary text; defaults to N active.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when there are no filters.

examples.title: Applied dashboard filters
examples.code:
<AppliedFilters
  filters={[
    { key: 'industry', label: 'Industry', value: 'Technology', onRemove: remove },
  ]}
  onClearAll={clearAll}
  onEdit={openPanel}
/>
examples.description: A count, removable chip and edit action.

antiPatterns.title: Don't duplicate FilterChips
antiPatterns.explanation: AppliedFilters already renders FilterChips. Use one summary per filter surface.
antiPatterns.example: // Avoid two chip rows with the same filters

accessibility.implementation: The wrapper uses aria-live=polite so count changes are announced
Delegates to FilterChips, which names each remove button and the clear action

compositionRules.relationship: Pair AppliedFilters with the panel; onEdit opens the panel or drawer
